title: Golden Horizon Landscape
description: A vibrant impressionistic landscape at sunset featuring rolling hills and fields in warm orange, red, and yellow tones. The foreground shows abstract structures and green patches under a bright sky with soft white and blue clouds, and a small orange sun sits on the distant horizon.
